name: New York Stock Exchange
scope: Main 18 Broad Street facade, Corinthian colonnade, pediment sculpture silhouette and roof envelope; exclude neighboring office towers.
era: surviving exterior represented by selected dated references

review.method: Qualla-first corpus search, then exact official explicitly public-domain agency/photographer originals and current model comparison.
review.notes: The exact NPS1909public-domain postcard confirms the fixed1903main18BroadStreet exterior: pale stone front, six tall Corinthian columns before a dark glazed wall, deep triangular pediment with grouped sculptural silhouette, entablature and lower arched-window/balcony rhythm. Current full, column, podium, pediment and entrance renders preserve these defining forms. The638x400hand-colored postcard is a historical overall reference; it does not prove current fine sculpture, literal lettering, glazing divisions or paint color. Retained architectural dimension/map controls establish the full main-building envelope and rear columned frontage; unseen rear/side detail, roof/plant setbacks, exact capital/figurative anatomy and north interface remain explicit medium-fi estimates. Fixed scope continues to exclude11WallStreetoffice tower,20BroadStreet, neighboring buildings, flags/banners, street scenery and interiors. No postcard pixels are embedded.
